Kitchen, meals & drinks

saucepan noun

modern

M-O s.v. pan: saucepan

1ōlla has a long o: it is the later form of aula. Ruling: ōlla with a long o.

2The vowel before ns is long, so ānsāta, from ānsa, a handle.

ōlla ānsāta12

saucepan, a pot with a handle

See also cooking pot.

SourcesLewis & Short: olla · Lewis & Short: ansatus

Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. pan: saucepan, pan: pot, cutlery: spoon: slotted spoon, sieve, sieve: colander, grater: cheese-grater, wire whisk, press: garlic press.
